proposed.text: What is the maximum angle of inclination permitted for an accessible escalator under the BP 344 IRR escalator specifications?

rationale.summary: BP 344 IRR sets the maximum escalator inclination at 30 degrees to the horizontal.
rationale.explanation: A 30° maximum inclination balances passenger throughput with stability for users who have difficulty maintaining balance on steeper slopes. Escalators steeper than 30° are not considered compatible with PWD-friendly use under BP 344. This value pairs with the S800-type tread (~804 mm) and 30 m/min speed limit.
common_misconceptions: Confusing the 30° escalator angle with the 1:12 (approximately 5°) ramp slope maximum
Thinking that 45° is a common escalator standard — it exceeds the BP 344 limit

proposed.explanation: BP 344 IRR caps escalator inclination at 30° to the horizontal for PWD-compatible use.
